final: WITH signal_baseline AS (SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) AS baseline FROM signals WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL), telescope_avgs AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse FROM signals WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL GROUP BY telescref), first_kept AS (SELECT a.telescref, a.avg_pulse, b.baseline FROM telescope_avgs a CROSS JOIN signal_baseline b WHERE a.avg_pulse > b.baseline), second_baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) AS baseline FROM first_kept), final_kept AS (SELECT f.avg_pulse, f.baseline AS first_baseline, s.baseline AS second_baseline FROM first_kept f CROSS JOIN second_baseline s WHERE f.avg_pulse > s.baseline) SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) AS mean_avg_pulse_rate, AVG(avg_pulse - first_baseline) AS mean_excess_over_first_baseline, AVG(avg_pulse - second_baseline) AS mean_excess_over_second_baseline FROM final_kept
